name: runner-bridge
description: Connect user-owned hosts without Cloudflare credentials, run local tools/files directly, and use GitHub only for verified engineering workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Connect a host once, then run local tools directly.
interface.longDescription: Use Bridge to self-connect a user-owned host without exposing Cloudflare credentials, PATs, SSH keys, or per-project setup. Direct Exec/Assets handle ordinary commands, local/private data and files; the GitHub engineering plane is used only for source mutation, trusted verification and publication.
